title: Remote source catalog manifest (seam I2)
description: Small, size-capped pointer the app polls, following the guided onboarding manifest pattern (Site/onboarding/v1). The app downloads catalogURL only when contentVersion is newer than what it holds, rejects a body larger than catalogByteCount or with a different SHA-256, and keeps its bundled or cached catalog on any failure. Both URLs must be https on the owner's site host.
